Manga Loader

Official builds of Manga Loader, a manga reader with offline downloads and a Rust core. Signed by the project maintainer.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://imsudoer.github.io/mangaloader/fdroid/repo
